home.metaDescription: Mobile money payment aggregation platform for Central Africa. One integration, multiple operators.
home.heroSubtitle: One API to accept payments from your customers, whatever their operator. Reliable, secure, built for Central Africa.
home.feature1Text: Connect MTN and Airtel through one clear, versioned REST API. One key, all operators.
home.feature2Text: HMAC-signed webhooks, idempotency, AES-256 encryption of sensitive data at rest.
home.feature3Text: Live transaction statuses and reliable webhooks with automatic retry and queryable logs.
home.feature4Text: Visualize your volumes, manage your API keys and track your settlements from a clean interface.
home.feature5Text: Your collected funds are settled to your Mobile Money every Friday without any action required.
home.feature6Text: Accept payments in XAF and USD. Conversion rates are updated daily.
home.featuresSectionTitle: Everything you need to collect payments
home.accountsSectionTitle: An account for every use case
home.accountsSectionSubtitle: Whether you're a seller or a buyer, AlphaPay adapts to your role. You can be both.
home.merchantDesc: Accept Mobile Money payments from your customers, generate QR codes and payment links, track your settlements.
home.merchantF2: QR code and payment link generation
home.merchantF5: Invite your team with dedicated roles and access
home.clientDesc: Pay for purchases easily via QR code or payment link from your Mobile Money, no bank account needed.
home.clientF1: Pay by QR code or link
home.step1Text: Sign up online, our team validates your file within 24–48h and sends you your API key.
home.step2Text: Copy 5 lines of code into your app or website. Our documentation guides you through each step.
home.step3Text: Transactions arrive in real time on the dashboard. Settlements land every Friday.
home.devSectionText: REST, JSON, signed webhooks, JavaScript SDK coming soon. Integrate AlphaPay in minutes and focus on your product.
home.trustText: AlphaPay aggregates MTN Mobile Money and Airtel Money in the Republic of Congo. More operators coming soon.

footer.tagline: Collect payments, manage your budget and send money with Mobile Money and a Visa card. AlphaPay never holds your money.

landing.badge: New · the AlphaPay app is coming to Android
landing.subtitle: Pay, collect and save with MTN MoMo, Airtel Money and your Visa card. A clear budget for individuals, simple tools for merchants.
landing.railTitle: The payment methods your customers use
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to manage money every day
landing.featuresText: The screens below are real screenshots of the AlphaPay app.
landing.f1Text: Till QR code, payment link sent over WhatsApp, or card payment on your phone: customers pay their way and you follow every payment live.
landing.f1b: Payment links over WhatsApp and SMS
landing.f1c: MTN MoMo, Airtel Money and Visa
landing.f2Text: Enter your income: AlphaPay suggests an envelope budget (food, transport, rent, school…) and warns you before you overspend.
landing.f2b: Categories that learn from your corrections
landing.f2c: Alerts at 80% and 100% of a budget
landing.f3Text: Set a goal (emergency fund, new phone, school fees) and let automatic round-ups of your spending fill it up.
landing.f3c: Your money stays in your account
landing.step1Text: A few questions to know whether you manage your money, get paid by customers, or both.
landing.step2Text: Add your MoMo, bank or cash: everything shows in one place.
landing.step3Text: Send with your @AlphaPay ID, collect by QR and reach your goals.
landing.diffTitle: Designed for Congo, built to last
landing.d1Text: An AlphaPay QR is all it takes: customers pay by Mobile Money or card, no app to install.
landing.d2Text: AlphaPay holds no funds: money goes straight to your MoMo or bank account.
landing.d3Text: An AlphaPay card for online purchases, issued by a licensed partner bank.
landing.d4Text: An ID or a QR code is enough: no need to share bank details.
landing.dashText: Stores and tills, payment links, invoices, reconciliation with operator statements: run everything from the web, in test or live mode.
landing.devTitle: A clear, documented, testable payments API
landing.devText: Create a test key, start a Mobile Money or card payment in one request, receive signed webhooks. Open your developer account on the website, then find it in the app.
landing.devA: Test and live keys, request log
landing.finalText: Open your free account: individual, merchant or developer.
